title: Fix 250
acceptance_criteria: After chough doctor --fix --reason withdraws a stale gate, that gate's gate-closed Timeline entry in the archived story holds the reason as its withdrawn field, in the person's words; doctor's JSON gives decision_reason on each decision finding it fixed and on no other finding; withdrawing still records no human decision.

answers.constraints: The specs/cli/cli.3md lesson on native tasks applies: human gates are plain text in tasks.md, not checkboxes, and the deltas are frozen at approval. REQ-history-002 keeps the Timeline append-only: the field is written with the entry, never added to an existing one.
